claims.statement: The Dilmun burial mounds in western Bahrain were built approximately 2200–1750 BCE.
Bahrain’s role as a trading centre supported elaborate burial traditions, preserved in extensive mound fields and royal tombs.

evidence.note: Dates describe this group of burial monuments, not the entire history of Dilmun. The property has 21 component sites; their individual map references remain to be checked.
